candidate.note: Meteorite crater: 24 m across and 3 m deep, Australia's smallest impact crater, on Dalgaranga station; daylight access, signposted, no facilities. Sits about 75 km west of Mount Magnet and 100 km north of Yalgoo, so it may fall in the Murchison (golden-outback) region; the proposer should resolve.

candidate.name: Yalgoo
candidate.note: Town: Mid West wildflower-route town (Shire of Yalgoo) and the gateway to the Dalgaranga crater; Wikipedia places it in the Mid West, though the region list does not name it, so the proposer should confirm the boundary.
